recipes.name: Deliciously Sweet Salad with Maple, Nuts, Seeds, Blueberries, and Goat Cheese
ingredients_raw: 0.25 cup white balsamic vinegar, or to taste
0.25 cup maple syrup, or to taste
0.25 cup grapeseed oil, or to taste

steps.text: Toss romaine lettuce, blueberries, dried cranberries, sunflower seeds, walnut pieces, feta, and goat cheese in a large bowl. Pour vinegar, syrup, and oil over the salad one at a time; toss until evenly coated. Season with salt.

raw_recipe.headline: Deliciously Sweet Salad with Maple, Nuts, Seeds, Blueberries, and Goat Cheese
raw_recipe.description: A tangy and sweet salad with dried cranberries and fresh blueberries add flavor to this delicious salad topped with nuts, feta, and goat cheese.

review.reviewBody: We liked this very much, even the husband, who isn't very fond of vegetables in general and NEW ways of serving vegetables in particular. (He actually could not I.D. the blueberries at first--he was pushing them off to the side until I asked him about it--thought they were black olives!). I did make a few changes based on necessity. *Resized the recipe to 10 so that I could use up 1 entire bag of romaine (which if you're curious, yields 8 cups of lettuce if you dont squish it down). *Used dried mixed berries instead of just dried cranberries. *Used less blueberries than called for and extra dried berries--this was a choice based on price, because I used fresh. I think I COULD have bought frozen blueberries, thawed & drained them though, because I don't really care if they stain my salad blue. *Used all low-fat feta & no goat cheese. None of the above changes make any real difference overall. Except maybe the feta or sunflower seeds--you need one or both of those to cut the sweetness. The real changes I made were in the dressing. *Used RED balsamic vinegar instead of WHITE because it's what I had. *Used pancake syrup instead of real maple because it's what I had. *Used olive oil instead of grapeseed oil because I couldn't find it at the grocery store. ~It was still tasty even with these substitutions. I mixed my dressing separately from my salad because the salad gets re-bagged and eaten all week and you can't do that with dressing all over it.

So good. Made a few minor changes and it was a huge hit. First, I decreased the maple syrup. Not even by half, but I was worried it would be too sweet for my crowd and I was right. I also feel like the feta was unnecessary. It was good with it, but if you don't have it, don't worry. I also made sure the pumpkin seeds were toasted and salted to also cut sweetness. I mixed all the ingredients for the dressing together with a good amount of salt & pepper in a mason jar and shook because I was transporting and I didn't want to dress too early. I also used half canola oil/half olive oil and dark balsamic because I had it and I thought it was perfect. Thanks, it was amazing.

Excellent salad! I made this for my mother's birthday and even my picky grandma raved about it. I found there was too much dressing when I tossed it. You could either cut down the dressing (ratio is 3:3:3), or add more lettuce (I reccommend more lettuce... that means more salad ;) ). This is an excellent and versatile recipe. Try it!!!!

I made this for a dinner party, and people could not stop telling me how delicious it was! For personal preference, I used almonds instead of walnuts, and used all feta cheese instead of a feta/goat cheese combination. I also added grape tomatoes and cut the oil slightly to 3 Tbsp, to make it slightly healthier. The dressing still tasted delicious, and was enough to cover two bags of romaine lettuce. Amazing - a real keeper!

This is a really wonderful salad! A great way to get kids to eat lettuce. I made the following substitutions (using what I had): almond slices instead of walnuts, feta cheese doubled omitting the goat cheese, red instead of white balsamic vinegar, and canola oil instead of grapeseed. I didn't have sunflower seeds either, but I think that it was still fine because of the almonds. The dressing was awesome. I recommend mixing the dressing together first before pouring on the salad because you might find that you don't need the full amount.
Instead of feta cheese, I used goat cheese and instead of sunflower seeds, used toasted walnuts and pecans, but it was delicious. The dressing is fantastic!
Love this salad. The only changes I made were to use feta cheese because I did not have goat cheese and to use olive oil rather than grape seed oil.

My husband and I liked this salad very much. I especially liked how quick, easy and adaptable the recipe is. I followed the recipe loosely, omitting the feta because we didn't have any on hand. I usually toast seeds and nuts for salads, but didn't this time; I didn't feel the salad suffered from the change and not toasting the nuts saved me a few minutes in preparation. I added some roasted chicken breast cut into cubes. This addition was a good balance for the sweet dressing. Also, the dressing was sweet for my taste so I used it very sparingly. I have dressing left over so guess I'll need to make the salad again tomorrow. ; )

Yummmy!! A crowd favorite at the bbq, so easy and quick. I used all ingredients, except traded pecans for walnuts. The dressing is simple but fantastic, try it the way it's listed. I bought extra ingredients, and made it a second day, added chopped cooked chicken breast, and had a wonderful salad for dinner.

Decided to give this a try based on all the great reviews, didn't expect all those ingredients would mix and taste so good together! 
It's the fourth time we make already!
Switched it up with blackberries and pecans once, also tasted really good.
But the original recipe given is the best.
Must try!
Used all goat's cheese, marion berries (instead of blueberries) and iceberg lettuce with fabulous results. This is a keeper.
We loved this salad! Made as written.
made this for our sewing group and it was a hit. Printed lots of copies of the recipe and they were all gone at the end of the day.

i have made it but with some change 
a little bit , i have made same thing but i add my son fav cream 
my family love that and , they always ask me to made it again
Used maple syrup asthat was what I had and the salad got rave reviews from our two guests. Added a bit more cheese as we love goat and feta. Will definitely make again.

I didn't add the full amount of oil and could cut back on the syrup a bit as well. Plenty of dressing and depending on the quality of your maple syrup, less might be better. This one is a certain keeper though.
Yummy! Loved the dressing.
I made this salad for guests and everyone loved it. The dressing was delicious! I'll be making this salad again.
Thank you people who actually make the recipe then rate it. It’s one thing to tweek it but don’t totally change it then brag about how good yours is. We want to know how you like THIS recipe.
Very good and can be tweeked. The dressing was easy and delicious!
